print('=== 3b. S1 by source wk32 vs wk33 ===')
for r in q("""SELECT CASE WHEN c.created_day BETWEEN 218 AND 224 THEN 'wk32' ELSE 'wk33' END wk,
  CASE WHEN c.acquisition_source='word_of_mouth' THEN 'wom' ELSE 'ads' END src,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) leads, COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) subbed
  FROM customers c LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id AND s.status!='lost'
  WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 218 AND 231 AND c.group_id='S1' GROUP BY wk, src"""):

print('=== 4. FRESH SUBS wk33: plan/price mix ===')

print('=== 5. r1 COHORT (start 195-201, first renewal due this wk) ===')

print('=== 6. MATURE (k>=2) dues this week & exits ===')
for r in q("""SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) alive,

print('=== 7b. PAYMENTS decode ===')

print('=== 8. RENEWAL CALENDAR wk34-37 ===')
for wk, lo, hi in [('wk34',232,238),('wk35',239,245),('wk36',246,252),('wk37',253,259)]:
    rows = q(f"""SELECT plan, listed_price,
      CASE WHEN (start_day + 30*(CAST(({hi}-start_day)/30 AS INT) )) - start_day = 30 THEN 'first' ELSE 'mature' END kind,
      COUNT(*) n, SUM(listed_price) dollars
      FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND (start_day + 30*(CAST(({hi}-start_day)/30 AS INT))) BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi}
      GROUP BY plan, listed_price, kind ORDER BY dollars DESC""")
    tot = sum(r['dollars'] for r in rows); cnt = sum(r['n'] for r in rows)
    a26f = sum(r['dollars'] for r in rows if r['kind']=='first' and r['plan']=='A' and r['listed_price']==26)
    b69f = sum(r['dollars'] for r in rows if r['kind']=='first' and r['plan']=='B')
    mat = tot - a26f - b69f
    print(f"--- {wk} d{lo}-{hi}: due {cnt} / ${tot:,} | A26f ${a26f:,} B69f ${b69f:,} mature ${mat:,}")
